# Barry's Blog

> A policy analysis and advocacy blog examining arts education equity, funding disparities, and nonprofit sustainability in the cultural sector.

Barry's Blog features in-depth commentary on arts education funding, interviews with cultural leaders, and analysis of equity issues affecting arts organizations and communities. The blog covers topics including state arts agency funding trends, creative aging programs, nonprofit management, and advocacy for unrestricted philanthropic support.

## Key Topics

- Arts Education
- Funding Disparities
- Education Equity
- Arts Policy
- Nonprofit Management
- Creative Aging
- Arts Administration
- Cultural Data
- Arts Organizations
- Community Arts
- Universal Access
- Arts Funding
- Grantmakers in the Arts
- WESTAF
- Marian Godfrey

## Featured Articles

- [Barry's Blog: Arts Ed Needs Help](https://blog.westaf.org/2019/10/arts-ed-needs-help.html): Analysis of arts education funding disparities and equity in New Jersey schools
- [Barry's Blog: Interview with Marian Godfrey](https://blog.westaf.org/2019/09/interview-with-marian-godfrey.html): Interview with Marian Godfrey on arts philanthropy and cultural data projects
- [Barry's Blog: Open Plea to GIA Delegates](https://blog.westaf.org/2019/09/open-plea-to-gia-delegates.html): Advocacy piece on unrestricted funding and arts sector sustainability
